conventions.compression: gzip level 9, empty filename, mtime 0; all text payloads use UTF-8 with LF.
conventions.counter_rows: Only JSON string tokens and line endings may change; number lexemes are preserved.
conventions.identifiers: Private addresses become rank labels or placeholders; user/workspace prefixes are redacted.
conventions.outcomes: No success, accuracy, or speed result is inferred; original receipt outcomes are retained.
conventions.published_hashes: Separate SHA256 of the published file and its decompressed UTF-8 payload.
conventions.source_hashes: SHA256 of local input bytes; original source paths are intentionally omitted.
conventions.source_states: Caller-provided source-state.json distinguishes each measured and later source state.
conventions.token_arrays: Exact integer arrays retained; token SHA256 uses little-endian unsigned 32-bit IDs.
